Definition: Baanah, the name of four Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Baanah is the name of four men — the son of Rimmon who murdered Ish-bosheth in his bed and was hanged by David for it, the Netophathite among David's mighty men, and two men who returned from Babylon and sealed the covenant. The same name belongs to a murderer, a warrior, and two men who came home to rebuild.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe David's judgment on Baanah is the line that holds the kingdom together: murder in the king's name is still murder, and the king who will not excuse it is the king God keeps.
